description: Users are unable to login, requests timeout after 30 seconds
paraphrase_3: Users can't sign in - connection timed out
root_cause: Database connection pool exhausted during peak load
fix_steps:
1. Check DB connection pool size in config.yaml
2. Increase pool_size from 10 to 50
3. Restart auth-service pod
4. Monitor connections via Grafana dashboard

description: Payment processing returns 500 Internal Server Error
root_cause: Stripe API key expired or rate limit exceeded
fix_steps:
1. Verify Stripe API key expiry in secrets manager
2. Rotate key if expired
3. Check Stripe dashboard for rate limit alerts
4. Redeploy payments service with new key

description: System emails (password reset, alerts) not being delivered
root_cause: SMTP credentials expired / SendGrid daily limit reached
fix_steps:
1. Check SendGrid dashboard for bounce/block logs
2. Verify SMTP env vars in deployment config
3. If limit hit: upgrade plan or wait for reset
4. Re-trigger failed notification queue

description: Third-party API calls returning 429 Too Many Requests
paraphrase_1: Getting rate limited on external API
root_cause: Insufficient rate limiting on outgoing API client
fix_steps:
1. Add exponential backoff to API client (min 1s, max 32s)
2. Implement request queue with concurrency limit
3. Cache responses where possible
4. Contact vendor for limit increase if needed

description: Worker pod memory usage grows unbounded, OOMKilled after 6h
paraphrase_1: Worker crashing with out of memory
paraphrase_2: OOM error on background job processor
paraphrase_3: Memory usage keeps growing in worker
root_cause: Event listener not removed after job completion
fix_steps:
1. Audit event listeners in worker/job.js
2. Add listener cleanup in job teardown
3. Add memory monitoring alert at 80% threshold
4. Restart affected pods
5. Deploy fix and monitor for 24h
